# MongoDB MCP Server

> Use the MongoDB MCP Server to interact with your MongoDB data from AI tools, assistants, and platforms.

- [Get Started with the MongoDB MCP Server](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/get-started.md): Get started with the MongoDB MCP Server to interact with your MongoDB deployments and data from AI clients.
- [What is the MongoDB MCP Server?](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/index.md): Use the MongoDB MCP Server to interact with your MongoDB data from AI tools, assistants, and platforms.
- [MongoDB MCP Server Configuration](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/configuration.md): How to configure the MongoDB MCP Server to interact with your MongoDB clusters from AI clients, including compatibility and prerequisites
- [Enable or Disable MongoDB MCP Server Features](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/configuration/enable-or-disable-features.md): How to enable and disable MongoDB MCP Server features such as: read-only mode, telemetry, system use, database index checks, and other MCP-specific tools
- [Export Data from MongoDB MCP Server](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/configuration/export-data.md): Learn how to export query and aggregation pipeline results to EJSON files using the MongoDB MCP Server export tool, including configuration options.
- [MongoDB MCP Server Memory Overflow](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/configuration/memory-overflow.md): How to configure the MongoDB MCP Server to guard against memory overflow
- [MongoDB MCP Server Configuration Methods](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/configuration/methods.md): Learn how to configure the MongoDB MCP Server using JSON configuration files, command line options, or environment variables to connect to your clusters.
- [MongoDB MCP Server Configuration Options](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/configuration/options.md): Reference guide for MongoDB MCP Server configuration options including connection settings, authentication, logging, security, and vector search features.
- [Start MongoDB MCP Server as a Standalone Service](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/configuration/standalone-service.md): Learn how to start and configure the MongoDB MCP Server as a standalone service using npx, environment variables, and HTTP transport options.
- [Troubleshoot MongoDB MCP Server](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/configuration/troubleshooting.md): Learn how to troubleshoot common issues with the MongoDB MCP Server including log file analysis, connection string problems, and HTTP transport issues.
- [MongoDB MCP Server Usage Examples](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/examples.md): Explore practical examples of using the MongoDB MCP Server to interact with your MongoDB data through natural language prompts.
- [Release Notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/release-notes.md): Explore the release notes for `mcp-server`, detailing new features, bug fixes, and updates across various versions.
- [MongoDB MCP Server Security Best Practices](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/security-best-practices.md): Learn MongoDB MCP Server security best practices including read-only mode, authentication, database access control, and deployment options for AI agents.
- [MongoDB MCP Server Security](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/security.md): Learn how to connect to a MongoDB deployment with various security configurations using the MongoDB MCP Server.
- [Connect with Kerberos](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/security/connect-with-kerberos.md): Learn how to connect to a MongoDB deployment using Kerberos authentication with the MongoDB MCP Server.
- [Connect with LDAP](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/security/connect-with-ldap.md): Learn how to connect to a MongoDB deployment using LDAP authentication with the MongoDB MCP Server.
- [Connect with OpenID Connect (OIDC)](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/security/connect-with-oidc.md): Learn how to connect to a MongoDB deployment using OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication with the MongoDB MCP Server.
- [Connect with Proxy](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/security/connect-with-proxy.md): Learn how to connect to a MongoDB deployment through proxy servers with the MongoDB MCP Server.
- [Connect with X.509 Certificates](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/local-mcp/security/connect-with-x509.md): Learn how to connect to a MongoDB deployment using X.509 certificate authentication with the MongoDB MCP Server.
- [MongoDB MCP Server Overview](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/overview.md): Use the MongoDB MCP or Remote MCP Server to interact with your MongoDB deployments and data in natural language from AI clients.
- [MongoDB MCP Server Prerequisites for Running Atlas Tools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/prerequisites.md): How to configure the MongoDB MCP Server prerequisites for running Atlas tools
- [MCP Access Models for MongoDB Atlas](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/remote-mcp/access-models.md): Compare the access models for connecting AI clients and agents to MongoDB Atlas through MCP, including user-delegated and programmatic access, and choose the right model for your use case.
- [Manage AI Client Access to Your Organization](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/remote-mcp/manage-ai-client-access.md): Enable, configure, audit, and disable AI client access to your MongoDB Atlas organization, including read-only and read-write modes and token settings.
- [Remote MCP Release Notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/remote-mcp/release-notes.md): TBD
- [Security, Governance, and Auditability](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/remote-mcp/security.md): Learn how MongoDB Atlas handles authorization, identity, credential isolation, and auditability when AI clients use delegated access to act on your behalf through OAuth.
- [MongoDB MCP Server Tools](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mcp-server/tools.md): Comprehensive guide to MongoDB MCP Server tools for Atlas management, local deployments, database operations, vector search, and AI-powered interactions.
